# Suvasthuk Architects

> Architecture, interior design, and construction firm in Bengaluru, India — practising since 1993. Founded by architect B K Muralidhar. 30+ years, 826+ clients, 1024+ projects. Based in Sahakar Nagar, Bengaluru.

Services: architectural design, interior design, full-contract construction, structural design, Vastu consultation, renovation, landscaping, layout planning, BBMP sanction plans & TDR procurement, elevation design.

Service area: Bengaluru and Karnataka, India.
Contact: suvasthuk@gmail.com · +91 94804 44666 · https://suvasthuk.com/contact
